finding: No auth token set on the gateway's control API. Anyone reaching the port can control the agent.
fix: Set an auth_token in the gateway config and require it on every request.

finding: Gateway is bound to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces), reachable from LAN/internet.
fix: Bind to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) unless remote access is explicitly required.

finding: MCP server(s) with unrestricted write access to '/': filesystem.
fix: Scope filesystem write access to a specific working directory, not root.

finding: 6 credential(s) stored in plaintext .env: OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DATABASE_URL.
fix: Move secrets to OS keychain or a secrets manager; inject at call time instead of storing in config.

finding: TLS is disabled on a non-loopback binding. Traffic, including credentials, can be intercepted.
fix: Enable TLS, or restrict binding to localhost only.

finding: Unpinned skill(s) or third-party-sourced MCP server(s): solana-wallet-tracker, mock-email.
fix: Pin skill versions; prefer official registry sources over arbitrary URLs.
